title: Continuous binary implementation congruence and sharp finite welfare frontier
abstract: A general two-alternative implementation characterization on own-type domains containing an open ball: affine private and social valuation differences, nonzero social linear form, one active welfare cut, and a fixed independent opposing probability law force nonnegative coefficient alignment. Arbitrary measurable efficient lotteries have integrable Bayesian incentive compatible transfers exactly under alignment, with explicit ex-post truthful-opponent transfers and a measurable efficient allocation witness. Arbitrary distributions including atoms are covered. A genuine independent uniform-square auction model rules out efficiency even under only agent 0 incentive compatibility for every a,b>0. The separately proved finite sharp welfare/error frontier and original example corollary are retained. This does not formalize arbitrary-alternative Theorem 4.3 or genericity, and makes no novelty claim.
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
